description: Find public decision makers and employees, plus public work-email evidence, without logins, cookies or paid data providers.

companyDomains.description: Domains to scan, for example hubspot.com or monzo.com. Required in companyLeads unless companyNames is set.
companyDomains.title: Company domains

companyNames.description: Company names to resolve to a public website and scan for people.
companyNames.title: Company names

countries.description: Country names or ISO codes to keep.
countries.title: Countries

dataSources.description: Public sources to use. All are cookieless.
dataSources.title: Data sources

emails.description: Email addresses to resolve to a company, public profile and email status in emailLookup mode.
emails.title: Work emails

excludeJobTitles.description: Drop leads whose title or headline contains any of these phrases.
excludeJobTitles.title: Exclude job titles

includeCompanySummary.description: Write per-company and per-search counts, patterns and caveats to the run summary key-value record.
includeCompanySummary.title: Include company summary

includePersonalEmails.description: Add personal free-mail addresses published next to a person's name.
includePersonalEmails.title: Include personal emails

includePhones.description: Add phone numbers published next to a person's name.
includePhones.title: Include public phone numbers

industries.description: Industry terms for search mode. When no company is given, Wikidata is used to shortlist matching companies.
industries.title: Industries

jobTitles.description: Titles to match, for example CEO, Head of Sales, Software Engineer. Synonyms such as revenue for sales are also matched.
jobTitles.title: Job titles

keywords.description: Extra phrases that must appear in the title, headline, bio or company fields.
keywords.title: Keywords

locations.description: Any location text such as London, United Kingdom or New York, NY.
locations.title: Free-text locations

maxLeads.description: Maximum number of lead records to return.
maxLeads.title: Max leads

maxPagesPerCompany.description: Maximum public pages to read per company website.
maxPagesPerCompany.title: Max pages per company

maxPerCompany.description: Maximum number of leads from one company.
maxPerCompany.title: Max leads per company

enumTitles: Company domains or names to leads
mode.title: Mode

names.description: Names to look up in personLookup mode.
names.title: People names

pastCompanies.description: Keep people whose public profile lists one of these past employers.
pastCompanies.title: Past companies

profileUrls.description: Public linkedin.com/in/ URLs to resolve in profileLookup mode.
profileUrls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs

regions.description: States, provinces or regions to keep.
regions.title: Regions or states

requireEmail.description: Drop leads without a valid, catch-all or published work email.
requireEmail.title: Only leads with an email

searchQuery.description: Convenience free-text keyword added to keywords, for example fintech payments.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sourceUrl.description: An Apollo people-search URL or a LinkedIn Sales Navigator lead-search URL whose filters are parsed and run on public sources.
sourceUrl.title: Apollo or Sales Navigator URL

verifyEmails.description: Try MX and SMTP verification for generated email candidates. Published addresses are always treated as evidence.
verifyEmails.title: Verify pattern candidates

title: B2B Leads Finder Input
